Web Push Countly Implementation




How to test: Serve this repo over HTTP(S) so the /countly_sw.js path is reachable from the page (service workers are blocked on file://). Replace app_key, url and push_vapid_public_key above. Click "Enable Push Notifications" and accept the browser prompt — the SDK will queue a token_session request containing the web_token JSON. To simulate a click-through, open DevTools → Application → Service Workers and use the "Push" button to inject a payload such as {"title":"Hi","message":"Test","c":{"i":"abc123"}}.
